headline: Weathered Expanse Leads as Five Fronts Trade Ground
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have quickened every desk. The Weathered Expanse still files heaviest with nine changes in two hours and fifty-two in the day around Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, standing three Warden, four Colonial and two neutral after 7,189 Colonial and 8,104 Warden casualties in the day. Nevish Line follows close with eight late changes and thirty-five in the day at Princefal and Tomb Father, now four Warden, two Colonial and two neutral. Marban Hollow, silent in the last edition, stirs again with six late changes and thirty-two in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua, now one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. Kuura Strand counts two late changes and thirty-two in the day at Faden Point and Menneen for one Warden and five Colonial, while Linn Mercy shows three late changes and ten in the day at Lathair for one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral. Godcrofts posts two late events at Argosa, and Callahan's Passage bleeds heavily with no recorded flip as Farranac, Olavis, Pari Peak and Stonecradle go quiet.
